title: Delivery into a session submits the user's half-typed draft

requirements.text: Root cause recorded: why delivery submits the draft
A message delivered while the input line holds a draft never submits or alters that draft
requirements.check: manual: Driver type partial text into a pane, deliver a tell, screen still shows draft unsubmitted and message unsent until cleared

requirements.text: A held message is delivered once the input line is empty again
requirements.check: manual: clear the draft in the driver run, message arrives in transcript

requirements.text: Verified in the running app without taking focus
requirements.check: manual: driver run with open -g, frontmost app unchanged

fields.symptom: A message the app delivers into a session (relay, tell, send) submits the user's half-typed input with it, joined: 'half typed thought about the lamRELAY: ...'
fields.root_cause: TerminalSession.submit pasted the message into the terminal and pressed Return without looking at the input line; Return submits the whole line, so any draft there went with it
whys: Delivery was written as if the input line were always empty: a terminal has no separate channel for programmatic input
Nothing read the screen to see what the user had typed
fields.corrective: Hold delivered messages while PromptScreen reads a non-empty draft on Claude Code's input line; flush them on the 0.4s tick once it is empty; retypes wait the same way
fields.preventive: PromptScreenTests pin the draft reading to real Claude Code screens

evidence: cause recorded: submit typed paste+Return blind to the input line; reproduced in driven app run2: screen showed 'half typed thought about the lamRELAY: reply with exactly the word PINEAPPLE' as one prompt
driven app run4 (Claude Code v2.1.325): draft 'half typed thought about the lam' on input, submitNth RELAY -> 6s later dump c-held: input still shows the draft, held: 1, no new prompt in conversation
run4: Ctrl-U cleared draft -> within 3s dump d-cleared shows '❯ RELAY: reply with exactly the word MANGO' submitted alone, held: 0; e-after shows '⏺ MANGO'
swift test --filter PromptScreen -> Executed 7 tests, 0 failures (empty, dim placeholder, typed, multi-row, boxed/shell mode, last box only, trust dialog -> nil)
app launched by binary with GENLOCK_APP_DRIVE (accessory policy), frontmost process before=Genlock after=Genlock (TJ's app stayed front); throwaway store and voice base

what: A held message waits as long as the input line reads non-empty; if Claude Code ever draws something non-dim under the prompt marker when empty, delivery stalls with no visible cue
verify: dumpScreen driver step on an idle session reads draft ""

answers.observed: dumps c-held (held:1, draft intact) and d-cleared (RELAY submitted alone) from the driven app, run4
answers.cause: measured: run2 reproduced the joined submit with the old path; run4 with the hold did not
answers.absence: the reader returning "" on the placeholder is observed (a-empty, dim cells), not inferred from a missing match
answers.assumption: mine: Claude Code draws the empty-line placeholder dim and the input between two rules; true for v2.1.325, a redesign breaks it (falls back to nil = deliver as before, or stalls if it reads text)
answers.falsify: a dump of an idle session reading a non-empty draft, or a relay landing mid-draft in TJ's real use
